title: WHAT?! (JonTron)
blurb: Full-body disbelief compressed into a single syllable, and one of the most-quoted reactions ever produced on YouTube. The delivery contains an entire argument, with the incredulity doing work that a paragraph of rebuttal would otherwise have to do. Play it at statements that break the laws of logic — impossible excuses, cursed food combinations, plot holes discovered in real life rather than in fiction. Nothing about it is proportionate. When something defies explanation, this clip demands one anyway and refuses to move on until somebody supplies it.
